name: go-http
description: Go REST API on the standard library net/http (Go 1.26 routing) with slog logging, graceful shutdown, a Postgres item store (pgx v5, embedded migrations) with an in-memory fallback, optional Redis cache, httptest tests and a static non-root Docker image.

included: Environment configuration (SERVER_ADDR, CORS_ORIGINS, DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_QUERY_TIMEOUT, REDIS_URL, LOG_LEVEL, LOG_FORMAT)
Liveness check (/health) and readiness check that pings Postgres (/ready)
Example CRUD endpoints behind an item.Store interface
Postgres item store on pgx v5 (pgxpool) when DATABASE_URL is set; in-memory store otherwise
Embedded SQL migrations applied on startup (schema_migrations table, advisory lock)
Redis cache via REDIS_URL with in-memory fallback
Dockerfile (golang:1.26-alpine build, static binary on alpine:3.22, non-root, healthcheck via `server -healthcheck` on the SERVER_ADDR port)
Table-driven httptest tests, go test -race (make test / make test-docker); Postgres store tests when TEST_DATABASE_URL is set (make test-db)
excluded: Migration tooling beyond the embedded runner (no down migrations; add goose or golang-migrate if you need them)
Pack-level docker-compose.yml (gpp's root compose runs the API, database and Redis)
